# astryx.Component { #anylumino.astryx.Component }

```python
astryx.Component(
    component_name,
    children=None,
    *,
    props=None,
    text='',
    label='',
    **kwargs,
)
```

Render a registered Astryx component by name.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type                        | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | Default    |
|----------------|-----------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| component_name | str                         | Frontend Astryx component name registered in the anylumino bridge.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | _required_ |
| children       | ChildInput                  | Child widget, sequence of widgets, or mapping of slot names to widgets.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | `None`     |
| props          | Mapping\[str, Any\] \| None | Additional JSON-safe props for the selected Astryx component. Reserved keys such as children, dangerouslySetInnerHTML, ref, key, items, tabs, segments, and metadata are filtered by the frontend bridge. See the Astryx docs for the selected component page, for example <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/Blockquote>. | `None`     |
